race.comment: RED SAMOVAR (12) shed the maiden tag at the Sunshine Coast last time out and will have derived a stack of confidence from that breakthrough victory. Winning rider Thompson sticks in the irons and can go back-to-back without surprising. HAD IT ALL (1) is a consistent conveyance who got a well-deserved win at Doomben at the latest effort. Stick with him. READY FOR AIMEE (2) strips fitter third-up, gets 3kg off with the claim and draws favourably in gate three. Ticks a few boxes for a race of this nature. MONAKEED (6) has a win and a second from two spins around this circuit and is another to get some weight relief. In the mix on best figures. DRAW ATTENTION (9) best of the rest while fresh.
